summary: PASS. The fix correctly addresses the heap churn issue by replacing double Vec::from() with Vec::drain(), eliminating one allocation per MQTT packet extraction. The logic was cleanly extracted into a testable launa-mqtt::packet module. All 17 unit tests pass, covering: empty/single-byte buffers (VAL-MQTT-013), partial packets (VAL-MQTT-012), two concatenated packets in sequence (VAL-MQTT-011), multi-byte remaining length encoding (VAL-MQTT-014), drain preserving remainder (VAL-MQTT-015), and no double-allocation (VAL-MQTT-010). The app compiles with cargo +esp check and all 421 workspace tests pass. One minor observation: architecture.md should be updated to reflect the new packet module in launa-mqtt.
